name: John Doe
title: Front-end Developer
bio:
Hi! I'm John Doe, a passionate front-end developer with a love for crafting beautiful, responsive, and user-friendly web interfaces. With a strong foundation in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, I specialize in building modern web applications using frameworks like React and tools like Tailwind CSS.

I believe great design and clean code go hand in hand. I'm always eager to learn new technologies, improve my skills, and contribute to meaningful projects that make the web a better place.

When I'm not coding, you’ll find me exploring new UI trends, reading about web performance, or experimenting with side projects.

Let’s build something awesome together!
